articles.title: GB News Daily Reflection — Monday 14th September 2026
articles.dek: In today's GB News Daily Reflection, we compare the bronze serpent in Numbers with Jesus being lifted up on the cross. Just as the Israelites were healed by looking at the serpent, Christians believe eternal life comes not by earning it through good deeds, but by looking to Jesus and trusting in him.
